wire.t: Nov 3: Week 8 is final. Achane in the Membrane's 155.28 had the top score, Lead Nagger hit 153.28, and Llamageddon's 88.14 was the low. Ivefallenandicantgetup's 31.08-point win over Llamageddon was the biggest margin and Stroud of Turin's 3.08-point win over MY DAD IS DEAD was the closest.

Nov 2: The Steelers and Titans are on bye in Week 9. That hits Lawrence of a Labia (Tony Pollard, Wan'Dale Robinson, Pat Freiermuth), Nothing to see here (PIT D/ST), Achane in the Membrane (Jaylen Warren) and Llamageddon (DK Metcalf).

Nov 2: Tony Pollard was the only Titans running back with a touch in Week 8 and has a 92% backfield opportunity share over his last three games. He scored 29.7 for Lawrence of a Labia, then goes on bye.
Nov 2: Michael Wilson (Cardinals WR) is reported to have two broken ribs heading into Week 9. He scored 26.8 in the Nothing to see here lineup Sunday.

Nov 2: Mike Washington Jr. took 25 of the Raiders' 28 backfield carries in Week 8, 89%, and Ashton Jeanty lost early-down work. NjigbaR Please! owns both and started Jeanty (10.3) with Washington (8.3) on the bench.

Nov 2: Trade rumors around Colts RB Jonathan Taylor are growing, per FantasyAlarm, with nothing confirmed. Seth McGowan would become the Colts' lead back if he moves. Llamageddon owns Taylor and MY DAD IS DEAD owns McGowan.

Nov 2: Jameson Williams has out-targeted Sam LaPorta 15 to 6 since LaPorta's contract comments and has caught five of Detroit's last six receiving touchdowns. Lawrence of a Labia has Williams (17.0 Sunday); Bijan is your daddy has LaPorta (6.5).

stories.title: Achane in the Membrane hung the top score of the week, 155.28, and is still 2-6
stories.dek: Week 8 is final: Lead Nagger scored 153.28, Ivefallenandicantgetup won the blowout by 31.08, and the commish left 37.1 points on his own bench.
body: Achane in the Membrane had the top score of Week 8 at 155.28 and beat Nothing to see here 132.98 by 22.30. Lead Nagger was next at 153.28 and beat Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 127.28 by 26.00. Nothing to see here's 132.98 was the third-best score of the week and lost anyway. The league average was 121.43, and only six teams cracked 126.

Ivefallenandicantgetup took the blowout, 119.22 to 88.14 over Llamageddon, a margin of 31.08. Llamageddon's 88.14 was the low of the week: Tre Tucker 0.0, DK Metcalf 1.4, Drake London 1.8 and DEN D/ST 2.0 all started, and only 6.7 points sat on the bench. The closest game was Stroud of Turin 107.78 over MY DAD IS DEAD 104.70, by 3.08.

Standings: NjigbaR Please!, Ivefallenandicantgetup and Lawrence of a Labia are all 6-2. NjigbaR Please! leads on points (1,020.80) and has the best all-play record in the league at 58-30. Lead Nagger, Breece'sBurdenDeflowered and Stroud of Turin are 5-3. Wild Goose Chase has the most points scored in the league (1,048.98) and is 4-4.

Bill_Buttlicker is 6-2 and picked up Tyler Allgeier on Sunday, who scored 37.1 on his bench while J.K. Dobbins (1.3) started. He won by 18.56 anyway, which is the only reason this paragraph is allowed to exist. Wild Goose Chase lost by 20.38 and would have won by 0.48 had Br0phy started Dylan Sampson (14.86) over RJ Harvey (0.0) and SEA D/ST (3.0) over NYJ D/ST (-3.0).

stories.title: Ja'Marr Chase and Chuba Hubbard put up 56.0 for Stroud of Turin; CeeDee Lamb and RJ Harvey gave Wild Goose Chase 12.8
stories.dek: RedDevil904 got the first full week of the Br0phy trade and it was not close.
body: Br0phy traded Ja'Marr Chase and Chuba Hubbard to RedDevil904 on Oct 29 for CeeDee Lamb and RJ Harvey. Week 8 was the first full week with the new players, and Ja'Marr Chase scored 31.1 and Chuba Hubbard 24.9 in the Stroud of Turin lineup, 56.0 combined. CeeDee Lamb scored 12.8 and RJ Harvey 0.0 for Wild Goose Chase, 12.8 combined.

That is a 43.2-point gap in one week. Stroud of Turin won by 3.08, so without the trade haul RedDevil904 loses to MY DAD IS DEAD. Wild Goose Chase lost by 20.38 and would have won by 0.48 with two lineup swaps, so the trade was not even the main way Br0phy lost.

Both sides have a case on paper: Wild Goose Chase has the most points scored in the league (1,048.98) and needed WR help, and Ja'Marr Chase and Chuba Hubbard are the kind of names you trade away at your own risk. One week is one week, but the box score is not ambiguous.

The other trade on the books, Nothing to see here and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered on Oct 26, also got its first real week. Bucky Irving (21.0) and Michael Wilson (26.8) gave ChuckJ10 47.8 against 16.1 from Chase Brown and 0.0 from A.J. Brown for rtmcruise. The full verdicts are in Trade Court.

stories.title: The commish left 37.1 on his bench and still won, because the league is that bad
stories.dek: Bill_Buttlicker started J.K. Dobbins for 1.3. Tyler Allgeier sat there with 37.1. Lawrence of a Labia is 6-2.
body: Lawrence of a Labia beat Bijan is your daddy 126.80 to 108.24, and Bill_Buttlicker would like everyone to focus on the 6-2. Do not focus on the lineup. Tyler Allgeier, who Bill_Buttlicker picked up on Sunday, scored 37.1 on the bench. Kyle Williams, picked up the same day, scored 12.3 there. J.K. Dobbins scored 1.3 in the lineup.

Swap Tyler Allgeier for J.K. Dobbins and the 126.80 is 162.60, which would have been the second-best score of the season. Tony Pollard (29.7) carried the lineup and takes the Week 8 Highest-Scoring RB payout, which means the commish wins his own payout. Auditors are welcome.

For the record, Br0phy dropped Tyler Allgeier on Oct 29 and the guy scored 37.1 on somebody else's bench the next Sunday. Wild Goose Chase lost by 20.38 and is 4-4 with 1,048.98 points, the most in the league. Make it make sense.

Week 9 is where the commish gets his comeuppance: Tony Pollard and Wan'Dale Robinson (Titans) and Pat Freiermuth (Steelers) are all on bye, and Ivefallenandicantgetup is a 12.5-point favorite. Sleeper lists Christian McCaffrey as questionable. Bill_Buttlicker will be fine, in the sense that he will have an excuse.

stories.title: MY DAD IS DEAD lost by 3.08 with Seth McGowan (7.02) on the bench behind Jordan Mason (2.0)
stories.dek: OneSillyBannana is 1-7. Two lineup spots decided a 3.08-point loss.
body: Stroud of Turin beat MY DAD IS DEAD 107.78 to 104.70, a 3.08-point game, the closest of the week. OneSillyBannana started Jordan Mason (2.0) and Jeremiyah Love (2.3) at running back and left Seth McGowan (7.02) on the bench. Swap Seth McGowan for Jordan Mason and MY DAD IS DEAD wins by 1.94.

Treylon Burks put up 11.1 on the bench too, though there was no open spot for a receiver without bumping a better player. Rome Odunze (12.7), Ladd McConkey (12.6) and Josh Downs (13.1) were in the lineup and none of that is on OneSillyBannana.

MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-7 with the lowest points total in the league (821.94) and an all-play record of 20-68. It has spent all $200 of its FAAB. Week 9 against Achane in the Membrane is an 18.5-point spread in the wrong direction.
There is a version of this season where OneSillyBannana is 3-5 and nobody is writing about it. We are not in that version.

columns.title: ONE HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE POINTS AND STILL 2-6! SOMEBODY CALL THE POLICE!
columns.dek: Achane in the Membrane had the top score of the week and I am LOSING MY MIND.
body: SIT DOWN! I have been in this press box for thirty years and I have NEVER seen it! Achane in the Membrane scored 155.28! The top score of Week 8! And MakeItRains is 2-6! TWO AND SIX! You do not go 2-6 with that offense! You do not!

The numbers are a CRIME SCENE! MakeItRains has 981.20 points, sixth in the league! And the most points against in the league, 1,058.04! The schedule is out here ROBBING him! Nothing to see here put up 132.98, which is the highest score by a loser this week, and it still lost TO THAT!

And the bench! Adonai Mitchell with 27.2 on the bench! Patrick Mahomes with 26.44 ON THE BENCH! That is 53.64 combined and Achane in the Membrane won by 22.30 with those guys SITTING! This team could start a different 155 and WIN AGAIN!

Meanwhile Ivefallenandicantgetup won by 31.08 and NjigbaR Please! sits at 58-30 in all-play! I respect it! But give me Achane in the Membrane in Week 9, 18.5-point favorite against MY DAD IS DEAD! That is the ONLY team I trust to turn a good score into a sixth place finish!

columns.title: I watched Pudge247's Week 8 box score. Two Bengals did 50% of it and a bench guy did 28.06.
columns.dek: Burrow 39.48. Higgins 37.5. Emmett Johnson 28.06 on the bench. Corey Kiner 3.8 in the lineup.
body: Lead Nagger scored 153.28 and beat Breece'sBurdenDeflowered by 26.00. Joe Burrow scored 39.48. Tee Higgins scored 37.5. That is 76.98 from two Bengals, 50.2% of the entire score. That is not a lineup. That is a hostage situation where the hostages scored.

Now watch the other tape. Emmett Johnson scored 28.06 on the bench. Corey Kiner scored 3.8 in the lineup. Pudge247 added Corey Kiner as a free agent on Oct 30. That is 24.26 points of pure softness left on the table, and Lead Nagger still won by 26.00.

I want to be fair. Jonah Coleman scored 20.4 and JAX D/ST scored 20.0. Those are good calls. George Pickens (6.8), Mason Taylor (4.9) and Corey Kiner (3.8) are not. Three starters under 7 and he still won. The league is soft.
Week 9: Lead Nagger is a 7.5-point favorite over Stroud of Turin, and Germie Bernard is on the Steelers' bye. Start Emmett Johnson. I'm tired of asking.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Five Rules for the Steelers-Titans Bye Week
columns.dek: Pittsburgh and Tennessee are on bye. The rules do not care. Neither do I.
body: The Steelers and Titans are on bye in Week 9. I wrote five rules while sitting in my lawn chair. They are numbered so you know they are correct.

1. Start your bye-week players anyway. A zero is just a very small number, and you get to be early to find out. Tony Pollard scored 29.7 last week, and if he scores 29.7 again on bye, I want credit. I want it in writing.
2. Never trust a defense that has scored 22.0. PIT D/ST scored 22.0 for Nothing to see here and is on bye. That means it is due for another 22.0, because byes cancel out. I did the math in the chair.

3. If a player has a bad week, drop him immediately. Ask Br0phy. He dropped Tyler Allgeier on Oct 29 and Allgeier scored 37.1 for somebody else on Sunday. This proves the system works, because Br0phy is no longer burdened by Tyler Allgeier.

4. A 3.08-point loss is just a win with a head start. MY DAD IS DEAD lost by 3.08 and Stroud of Turin won by it. Put them together and the league has zero net change. 5. Always bring a snack. Do not share it with Seth McGowan.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: 76.98 is Exactly Half of 153.28, and That Changes Everything
columns.dek: The numbers do not lie. They just do not tell you what they mean.
body: My model for Week 8 is simple. Joe Burrow scored 39.48 and Tee Higgins scored 37.5. Add them and you get 76.98. Lead Nagger scored 153.28. Divide one by the other and you get 0.502, which is basically 0.5, which is basically one. So Pudge247 does not need a lineup. He needs two Bengals.

Now look at the standings. NjigbaR Please! is 58-30 in all-play, which is 65.9%. MY DAD IS DEAD is 20-68, which is 22.7%. Subtract them and you get 43.2 percentage points. The distance between first and last is 43.2. The distance between Ja'Marr Chase (31.1) plus Chuba Hubbard (24.9) and CeeDee Lamb (12.8) plus RJ Harvey (0.0) is also 43.2 points. This is not a coincidence. I decline to explain it.

The real indicator is the 3.08. Stroud of Turin beat MY DAD IS DEAD by 3.08 points. 3.08 is 2.9% of Stroud of Turin's 107.78, so by my framework RedDevil904 is 97.1% safe from everything. Please do not check my math. Check my confidence.
Conclusion: the team with the most points after Week 8 is Wild Goose Chase at 1,048.98, and it is 4-4. Points do not cause wins. Wins cause points. That is why I keep correlation as a separate tab.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.
